name: Zuma Rock
description: A large natural monolith with a human face. Major landmark and tourist attraction near Abuja.

name: Abuja National Mosque
description: National mosque of Nigeria built in 1984. Features gold dome and four minarets.

name: Nigerian National Christian Centre
description: Non-denominational Christian church completed in 2005. Major religious landmark.

name: Jabi Lake Mall
description: Popular waterfront shopping mall with restaurants, cinema, and boat rides on Jabi Lake.

name: Millennium Park
description: Largest public park in Abuja designed by Manfredi Nicoletti. Great for picnics and events.

name: Aso Rock
description: 400-meter monolith overlooking the Presidential Complex and National Assembly.

name: Wuse Market
description: One of Abuja's largest markets. Sells food, clothing, electronics, and local crafts.

name: Arts and Crafts Village
description: Open-air market for traditional Nigerian art, sculptures, paintings, and souvenirs.
